prompt: Implement a modular Real-Time Multiplayer Game Server in C# with three decoupled layers: (1) UDP Network Transport managing unreliable datagram packet sequencing, (2) State Synchronization Engine maintaining authoritative world simulation ticks, and (3) Client Reconciliation Subsystem handling input lag compensation.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Transport Score: 0-5 (Evaluates UDP socket handling and sequence numbering)
Module 2 Simulation Score: 0-5 (Evaluates fixed-timestep world loop consistency)
Module 3 Reconciliation Score: 0-5 (Evaluates input prediction and correction math)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates high-frequency network performance and stability)
